translation.title: Sugarloaf Mountain via Urca: Four-Hour Tour
translation.lead: After breakfast, set off on a four-hour half-day excursion. The cable car takes you first to Morro da Urca and then to the summit of Sugarloaf Mountain.
included: Admission tickets as specified in the itinerary.

hero.alt: Praia Vermelha at the foot of Sugarloaf Mountain in Urca — illustration
hero.hover: Praia Vermelha at the foot of Sugarloaf Mountain in Urca — illustration

translation.body: From the summit, take in views of Guanabara Bay, Copacabana Beach, the mountains and the coastal islands. You can also see the Rio–Niterói Bridge and the statue of Christ the Redeemer on Corcovado.
